preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(3 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Length of array a for each test case is between 3 and 200,000.
Sum of all n values across all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(m <= n + 5 for m in ms)
postconditions.description: Number of operations for each test case is at most n + 5.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in ops) for ops in ops_list)
postconditions.description: Each operation pair (x, y) has valid indices within the array and x is not equal to y.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for a in a_final if a == 1) == n - 1 and sum(1 for a in a_final if a == 2) == 1 for a_final in a_final_list)
postconditions.description: Final array consists of n - 1 ones and 1 two after performing the operations.
